answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The relic holds work receipts rather than names, so the garden of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the atlas of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
